column1: # Wall seconds of one package under `go test` in the go-quality test leg (CHAOS-10355), the weight ci/go_race_shard.awk balances the test shards by
# (`check_go.sh ci-leg test K N`). A row is the LARGER of the warm and the cold value (CHAOS-13730), so the plan fits both kinds of run:
# - warm (CHAOS-13622): MEDIAN (rounded to whole seconds) of the uncached `ok <pkg> <n>s` lines of the test legs of the 5 successful full-plan
#   go-quality push runs on main since the 10-leg plan (43366218676, 43369751192, 43376042584, 43377857475, 43379257796; up to 5 values per package);
# - cold: the `ok` line of the test legs of go-quality run 6221 (a go.sum change: the test-result cache missed; the larger of the two attempts of leg 1).
# A split package's (ci/go_test_splits.tsv) value of one run is the sum of its parts' lines: the weight of the whole package.
# Rows: every package of warm median or cold value >= 20 s, every package of >= 20 s in go-quality test leg 1 of pull request run 43558584492 (its `ok`
# value), and every package that already had a row (a row of a package with no uncached line in those
# runs keeps its earlier value), among them the packages the unweighted-slow guard flagged on a starved shard (internal/auth/identity/saml,
# internal/cigates/bigboyrender, internal/auth/identity; CHAOS-13422). A package with no row weighs 1.
# internal/cigates/testshard (CHAOS-13800): the larger of the warm median of push runs 43604205978, 43605920383, 43606101382, 43615706484 and cold push run 43554424993.
# No part rows (CHAOS-13668): the test-leg plan derives a split package's part weights from its test rows in ci/go_test_split_weights.tsv; a <key>#<part> row is refused.
# The weights only need to be roughly right: a wrong one costs balance, never coverage (the shards always partition `go list ./...`). Key = import path relative to the module root.
# Sorted (LC_ALL=C), no duplicates; internal/cigates/testshard checks each row names a real package.
